name: odin
display_name: ODIN (28 nm FDSOI, Frenkel 2019): one 256-neuron, 64k-synapse crossbar core

geometry.name: odin_stock_core
geometry.provenance: frenkel2019odin: "ODIN is based on a single 256-neuron 64k-synapse crossbar neurosynaptic core ... each synapse occupies 4 bits" (Trans. BioCAS 13(1), pp.145-158; upstream doc/README.md Sec.1 and Sec.3.2), transcribed from the RTL at ChFrenkel/ODIN @ 1781931. The declared core is the physical one, 256 rows x 256 neurons, with one static sign bit per presynaptic row for all 256 neurons of the core (SPI_SYN_SIGN, src/synaptic_core.v:128): weight_sign_granularity 'per_axon'. A logical input whose weights onto a core mix signs takes two rows (W+ then W-), so dense layers use the rows in sign pairs (127 logical inputs and the bias row per core). Permissions transcribed from the odin_stock_core declaration of the odin-fpga-infra branch (f08c8efa, mapping/platform/imc_platforms.py).

named: unbounded membrane for the 8-bit saturating one
faithfulness.note: ODIN integrates and fires per event (the serial fold of the odin-fpga-infra branch) into a saturating 8-bit membrane (membrane_bits 8 in the same declaration); this tree has neither a per-event soma law nor a membrane width, so a deployment on the bundle runs the declared per-cycle spiking law, with an unbounded membrane, on ODIN's geometry, weights, permissions and physics. ODIN's per-axon weight sign is declared (weight_sign_granularity 'per_axon') and is exact, not a departure: the mapper splits each mixed-sign row into an excitatory and an inhibitory row (W = W+ + W- on the integer grid).

notes: Population 1 is the degenerate single-core case the curated table quarantines, so the claim class is quarantined; a multi-core study declares the core count through target_overrides with a note. allow_coalescing and allow_neuron_splitting are false as the odin_stock_core declaration states (odin-fpga-infra f08c8efa, mapping/platform/imc_platforms.py capabilities: 'No inter-core partial-sum transfer and no re-thresholding of a partial sum'); a deployment that needs either declares it through target_overrides with a note, and its faithfulness names it. The declaration's allow_scheduling false is not bundled: the config registry defines allow_scheduling as a deployment choice, and its default is false.
